text:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused for chart service-batch v5.0.2 -> v5.1.0. Reason: values checksum changed and image tag 'build-20260715' maps to two different digests in registry. Auto-promotion locked.

maya: saw the dup tag. registry shows sha256:aa7f...c01 and sha256:bb9d...d22 both with tag build-20260715 (pushed 01:12 and 03:45 UTC).

rich: QA ran on aa7f...c01. the later image includes a tiny GC tweak we haven't validated. picking wrong digest could break retention windows.

olga: options: 1) pin to QA digest and run extended canary; 2) rebuild/push single-tagged image; 3) abort promotion and re-run CI after fix.

release-manager: prefer 1) pin and extended canary if it's a small change. we need PR with overlay and annotation, plus a short smoke run (10m).

infra-engineer: note: if the duplication is due to registry replication, we should also file INFRA-721. I'll capture region metadata.

maya: opening overlay PR to set `image.digest: sha256:aa7f...c01` under `overlays/batch/pin-image.yaml`. will keep the human-friendly tag in values for readability.

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/batch/PR-1108 — includes digest pin and changelog note referencing duplicate tag.

deploy-bot: Detected new commit on branch `pin-image-1108`. Creating locked promotion candidate `pin-batch-1108`. To continue promotion, add annotation `helm.redwood/allow-promotion: "pin-batch-1108"` to the release object, or run `/deploy override pin-batch-1108` by @release-manager.

release-manager: running `/deploy override pin-batch-1108` now.

deploy-bot: Override accepted from @release-manager. Promotion resumed. Starting canary (3% traffic) in us-west. Extended smoke enabled (10m).

rich: kicking off smoke: `smoke/batch --env=canary --checks=health,retention`

(smoke output)
```
2026-07-30T14:02:05Z  health OK
2026-07-30T14:06:21Z  retention-check OK (old files GCed appropriately)
2026-07-30T14:07:02Z  latency P95=88ms
```

olga: traces show small uptick in S3 PUT latency but not impacting success rate. moving to 25% now. tracker: #DEVOPS-3999 updated with digest and PR.

maya: reminder: add annotation `release.redwood/force-smoke: "true"` in release object during the lock so deploy-bot triggers manual smoke job (we added this earlier to the runbook).

release-manager: notes draft: "Pinned image digest for service-batch to sha256:aa7f...c01 due to duplicate tag build-20260715; extended canary passed; minor S3 latency observed but within SLOs." Will push final release notes on promote.

infra-engineer: filing follow-up INFRA-721: investigate registry replication and prevent tag reuse within 24h window. Also propose registry alert on duplicate tag pushes.

deploy-bot: Promotion completed to 100% in us-west. Lockfile `pin-batch-1108` closed. Rollback triggers still active (error threshold 2% over 3m).

rich: will monitor metrics for 30m. thanks all :+1: 

maya: I'll add the runbook blurb about `deploy-bot` override and digest pin steps. PR-1108, #DEVOPS-3999, INFRA-721 are the artifacts.

release-manager: closing thread. :white_check_mark:
